screen_window.scroll_convention: GBA background area is 256x256 px and wraps; the screen shows the 240x160 window starting at (bg2_hoffs, bg2_voffs).

unknowns.lit_cell_definition: the literal criterion 'tile index >= 256' selects all 1024 cells because the whole BG2 tilemap is built from the overlay tile set; 'lit_cells' therefore uses the stricter non-blank-tile rule and both counts are given
unknowns.overlay_semantics: unknown: whether the lit cells are the reachable range highlight or the unreachable dim is not decidable from the receipts
